title: ZonePublicationRetryPolicy
description: Optional retry policy embedded in or resolved for a ZonePublicationRecord. Governs maximum attempt count, backoff, dead-letter behavior. Retry policy is advisory metadata — it does not authorize remote mutation or remediation.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of publication attempts before the outcome is terminal.

retry_backoff_seconds.description: Base backoff delay in seconds between retry attempts.

retry_strategy.description: Backoff strategy. 'fixed' uses a constant delay. 'exponential' doubles the delay each attempt.

dead_letter_on_terminal.description: If true, write a dead-letter artifact when the terminal attempt fails.
